{{Quote|Take Chack aft and work your way forward. Let him take his time. Tag anything that gets his attention, and we'll deal with it separately.|Unidentified female chief customs inspector|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] chief who served in the [[Eriadu Customs and Immigration]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]],<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> she and two other custom officials boarded a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. They brought [[Chack]], a saurian quadruped who could sniff out contraband, and the chief ordered her subordinates to inspect the [[Arwen Cohl's freighter|freighter]] while she obtained the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] manifest from the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Unbeknownst to the chief, the freighter's occupants were [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] aligned with the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. The mercenaries were tasked with assassinating [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] being held on the planet.<ref name="CoD" />

[[Rella]], leading the team of mercenaries, forced the chief at gunpoint to order a larger inspection team to board the freighter, allowing the mercenaries to capture them and their [[picket ship]], as well as the chief's uniform, which Rella wore. Rella then ordered the chief to message the custom officials on the planet that they were bringing down shipments of contraband and that these were to be delivered to a [[Unidentified Eriadu customs building|customs building]] where several other Nebula Front members were waiting. Upon landing at the [[Eriadu Spaceport|spaceport]], [[Boiny]], one of the mercenaries, injected a clear liquid into the chief using a [[styrette]], rendering her unconscious.<ref name="CoD" />

The chief later awoke and was rescued by Eriadu [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] from the customs building, where she recounted the events that had occurred and identified the mercenaries she recognized.<ref name="CoD" />
